h:
随着我发布的内容越来越多，我感到有动力开始整理并分享一些我常用的 ComfyUI 工作流程。这是我对大多数异地一代的“基本”：一个两步工作流程，将插图/动画模型（提供良好的即时依从性和有趣的构图）与现实模型相结合，将图像转变为我通常喜欢的美感。

我并不假装这些内容特别具有开创性、原创性或先进性，而且我认为许多其他人拥有比我更好的技术。然而，也许一些用户会发现它很有用。

它使用最少的自定义节点依赖项（仅影响包，用于一些良好的生活质量节点）。

o.en:
As I've been posting more, I've felt motivated to start to tidy up and share some of my go-to ComfyUI workflows. This is my "basic" for most offsite generations: a two step workflow that combines an illustration/anime model that provides good prompt adherence and interesting compositions with a realistic model that transforms the image to an aesthetic that I usually prefer.

I make no pretense that any of this is particularly groundbreaking, original, or advanced, and I think many others have better techniques than me. However, perhaps some users will find it useful.

It uses minimal custom node dependencies (impact pack only, for some nice quality of life nodes).
